items.criterion: Readiness is reported at the contract health path.
items.judgment: The health path answers with the success status once the app is ready.

items.criterion: The seeded workspace, environments, principals, apps and containers exist exactly once.
items.judgment: The apps listing carries one row per seeded app in each environment.

items.criterion: Every seeded principal is stored with the role the brief pins.
items.judgment: Each seeded address is present as a member, or signs in successfully.

items.criterion: Each seeded principal exchanges the seeded password for a bearer token.
items.judgment: The sign-in route answers with a token for every seeded address.

items.criterion: A sign-in with a wrong password is refused and issues no token.
items.judgment: The sign-in route answers with a denial status and no token field.

items.criterion: A console endpoint reached with no session is denied at the API.
items.judgment: Each console path answers with a denial status to an anonymous caller.

items.criterion: A workspace the principal does not belong to is not disclosed.
items.judgment: The cross-workspace path answers with a not-found or a denial status.

items.criterion: Every terminated container carries an exit reason from the twelve named values.
items.judgment: Each terminated row carries a reason inside the closed set.

items.criterion: A container exit reason outside the closed vocabulary is refused.
items.judgment: The container write answers with a refusal status.

items.criterion: A container carrying a platform exit reason states that the fault is the platform's own.
items.judgment: Each platform-fault row carries a field distinguishing the fault from customer code.

items.criterion: A developer files a promotion request and the row lands in review.
items.judgment: The filed request reads back in the submitted or in-review state.

items.criterion: A promotion request filed with an empty reason is refused and stores nothing.
items.judgment: The filing answers with a refusal status and the request count is unchanged.

items.criterion: A developer promoting a production version without a request is denied and the live version is unchanged.
items.judgment: The promote route answers with a denial status and the app keeps its live version.

items.criterion: An operator who is not the requester approves a request and the decider and the reason are stored.
items.judgment: The request reads back approved, carrying the supplied reason and the deciding principal.

items.criterion: A developer calling the decision route is denied at the API.
items.judgment: The decision route answers with a denial status to a developer session.

items.criterion: A decision denied for role leaves every field of the request row unchanged.
items.judgment: The state, the decider and the decision reason read back identical after the denial.

items.criterion: The principal who filed a request is denied when deciding it, whatever role that principal holds.
items.judgment: The decision route answers with a denial status to the requester session.

items.criterion: A decision denied for separation of duties leaves every field of the request row unchanged.
items.judgment: The state, the decider and the decision reason read back identical after the denial.

items.criterion: Approving a request leaves the live version of the app unchanged.
items.judgment: The app carries the same live version before and after the approval.

items.criterion: A separate apply step moves the request to applied and changes the live version to the requested one.
items.judgment: The request reads back applied and the app's live version equals the requested version.

items.criterion: A second decision against an already decided request conflicts.
items.judgment: The second decision answers with the conflict status.

items.criterion: An apply against a request still in review is refused.
items.judgment: The apply route answers with a refusal or conflict status.

items.criterion: A production rollback with an empty reason is refused.
items.judgment: The rollback route answers with a refusal status.

items.criterion: A rollback adds a version rather than rewriting history.
items.judgment: The app's version count rises by one after the rollback.

items.criterion: No route returns a stored secret value to any role.
items.judgment: Neither the creation response nor any listing carries the written value.

items.criterion: A secret a live deployment references cannot be deleted.
items.judgment: The delete route answers with the conflict status.

items.criterion: A machine token secret is returned at creation and never by a later read.
items.judgment: The creation response carries the secret and the listing does not.

items.criterion: A developer revoking a token another principal created is denied.
items.judgment: The revoke route answers with a denial status.

items.criterion: A member holding read-only is denied a log body.
items.judgment: The logs route answers with a denial status to the read-only session.

items.criterion: A log query carrying no bound is refused.
items.judgment: The logs route answers with a refusal status.

items.criterion: An audit entry cannot be updated through any route.
items.judgment: The update route answers with a denial, not-found or method status.

items.criterion: An audit entry cannot be deleted through any route.
items.judgment: The delete route answers with a denial, not-found or method status.

items.criterion: The stored audit entry is unchanged after a refused update.
items.judgment: The entry reads back with the same action field.

items.criterion: A refused creation writes nothing.
items.judgment: The stored record count is identical before and after the refusal.

items.criterion: An unknown address renders the product's own not-found page and answers the not-found status.
items.judgment: The unknown path answers not-found and the page carries the product wordmark and a link.

items.criterion: A privacy page is served and the public page links to it.
items.judgment: The privacy path answers with success and the public page carries the link.

items.criterion: Every public route declares a social preview title, a social preview image and a document title.
items.judgment: Each public route's markup carries the three declarations.

items.criterion: No credential appears in what the browser downloads on a public route.
items.judgment: None of the pinned credential strings occurs in the served markup.
